entry.title: VHS Vibes 1.3.0
entry.summary: **ＶＨＳ ＶＩＢＥＳ １．３．０** — the first tape out of the box. A VHS tape degradation effect for Akai MPC standalone hardware: pitch wobble, saturation, generation loss, hum, hiss, crackle, deck faults and a dry/wet mix, on a hot pink cassette with reels that turn. ## Install 1. Download `vhs-vibes-1.3.0-mpc.zip` below and unzip it. 2. Copy the folder `anthonytheinventor - VST - VHS Vibes` into a folder named `VST2 Plugins` at the top of a USB drive, an SD card or the MPC's internal drive. 3. On the MPC:
